correctness.rationale: Finite differencing of floor(n/d)^2 yields the divisor recurrence a(n)=-1-Σ_{1<d<n,d|n}a(d)(2n/d-1). Induction modulo 2 with the Möbius divisor identity gives a(n)≡μ(n) (mod 2) for every n. For squarefree n=∏p_i, in R=Q[z_i]/(z_i^2) the convolution generating series satisfies S=1-(A-1)/(2B-A), A=∏(1+z_i), B=∏(1+p_i z_i). Since B/A=exp(Σ(p_i-1)z_i), the Taylor expansion of 1/(2e^w-1) yields coefficients C_j=Σ_{ell>=1}ell^j/2^ell; coefficient extraction cancels the full-subset term and leaves exactly the sum over proper subsets. Positive moments force |a(n)|>1 for squarefree composite; nonsquarefree values are even, so a(n)=-1 iff prime. Independent integer recurrence and moment/prime checks through 1399 agree, but the proof is symbolic all-domain.
residual_risks: The all-squarefree polynomial does not give full closed values at nonsquarefree n.
